props.paused: Stops the content from scrolling on its own. Dragging and the arrows still move it.
props.speed: How fast the content scrolls, in pixels per second.
props.reverse: Scrolls the content towards the start instead of the end.
props.pauseOnHover: Pauses the scrolling while the pointer is over the component.
props.mask: Fades the content out at both edges. Pass a number or CSS length to set the gradient size.
props.draggable: Allows scrubbing the content by dragging it with a pointer or finger.
props.wheel: Allows scrubbing the content with a mouse wheel or trackpad. A horizontal carousel takes sideways swipes and shift+wheel, a vertical one takes the regular wheel and stops the page from scrolling while the pointer is over it.
props.shiftDistance: How far one arrow click moves the content.
props.showArrows: Displays navigation arrows over the content.
props.prevIcon: Icon used by the arrow that moves towards the start.
props.nextIcon: Icon used by the arrow that moves towards the end.

slots.separator: Rendered after every item, including across the seam between repeated copies.
slots.prev: Replaces the arrow that moves towards the start.
slots.next: Replaces the arrow that moves towards the end.
